title: VIllage Utilties
description: Village Utilities adds village and villager management tools to help you understand and maintain your villages without guesswork. Inspect village health, see how many beds are in your village, and the number of job sites that you have.
body:
Adds village and villager management tools to help you understand and maintain your villages without guesswork. Inspect village health at a glance, view individual villager stats, and let the mod handle small quality-of-life fixes that vanilla leaves broken.

**Getting Started
**
Village menus — Shift + Right Click a villager or village block to open village management screens
Village overview — Right click a Village Ledger, or press U while inside a village, to view village-wide information

**Village Information
**When inspecting a village, you can view at a glance:

Total villager count
Number of available job sites
Beds and their occupancy status

This makes managing and expanding villages significantly more intuitive, especially in survival worlds where village health can be difficult to assess.

**Villager Information
**Individual villagers now display:

Current health
Inventory contents
Their reputation/opinion of the player

No more guessing why a villager won't trade with you or wondering if they're about to die.

**Village Quality of Life
**Several small improvements are made to village environments:

Water containment — Prevents water from flowing out of village farms, keeping them functional without player intervention
Door clearing — Removes obstructions in front of doors to improve villager pathing
Farmland repair (disabled by default) — Optionally allows farmer villagers to replace trampled farmland on their own

**Compatibility
**
Requires NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1
Untested on dedicated servers — use in that environment at your own discretion
